+"""Behaviour-residual directional transport with covariance whitening."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's directed residual transport and radius penalty."""
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("lambda", 1e-4))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    nu = float(parameters.get("nu", 1e-6))
+    radius_target = float(parameters.get("s", 1.0))
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype).reshape(-1)
+    residual = target - source
+    denom = mask.sum() + epsilon
+    covariance = ((residual * mask[:, None]).T @ residual / denom).detach()
+    # Stabilize the inverse while retaining the specified detached covariance.
+    covariance = covariance + epsilon * torch.eye(
+        covariance.shape[0], device=covariance.device, dtype=covariance.dtype
+    )
+    whitened = torch.linalg.solve(covariance, residual.T).T
+    projected = whitened @ codebook.T
+    direction = projected / (projected.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    p = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=1)
+    q = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=1)
+    h = ((q - p) * direction).sum(dim=1)
+    transport = (mask * F.relu(margin - h).square()).mean()
+
+    centered = codebook - codebook.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
+    radius_penalty = (centered.square().sum(dim=1) - radius_target).square().mean()
+    return lam * transport + nu * radius_penalty

+"""Behaviour-residual directional transport with covariance whitening."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's directed residual transport and radius penalty."""
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("lambda", 1e-4))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    nu = float(parameters.get("nu", 1e-6))
+    radius_target = float(parameters.get("s", 1.0))
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype).reshape(-1)
+    residual = target - source
+    denom = mask.sum() + epsilon
+    covariance = ((residual * mask[:, None]).T @ residual / denom).detach()
+    # Stabilize the inverse while retaining the specified detached covariance.
+    covariance = covariance + epsilon * torch.eye(
+        covariance.shape[0], device=covariance.device, dtype=covariance.dtype
+    )
+    whitened = torch.linalg.solve(covariance, residual.T).T
+    projected = whitened @ codebook.T
+    direction = projected / (projected.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    p = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=1)
+    q = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=1)
+    h = ((q - p) * direction).sum(dim=1)
+    transport = (mask * F.relu(margin - h).square()).mean()
+
+    centered = codebook - codebook.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
+    radius_penalty = (centered.square().sum(dim=1) - radius_target).square().mean()
+    return lam * transport + nu * radius_penalty

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's directed residual transport and radius penalty."""
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("lambda", 1e-4))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    nu = float(parameters.get("nu", 1e-6))
+    radius_target = float(parameters.get("s", 1.0))
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype).reshape(-1)
+    residual = target - source
+    denom = mask.sum() + epsilon
+    covariance = ((residual * mask[:, None]).T @ residual / denom).detach()
+    # Stabilize the inverse while retaining the specified detached covariance.
+    covariance = covariance + epsilon * torch.eye(
+        covariance.shape[0], device=covariance.device, dtype=covariance.dtype
+    )
+    whitened = torch.linalg.solve(covariance, residual.T).T
+    projected = whitened @ codebook.T
+    direction = projected / (projected.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    p = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=1)
+    q = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=1)
+    h = ((q - p) * direction).sum(dim=1)
+    transport = (mask * F.relu(margin - h).square()).mean()

+"""Behaviour-residual directional transport with covariance whitening."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's directed residual transport and radius penalty."""
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("lambda", 1e-4))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.05))
+    nu = float(parameters.get("nu", 1e-6))
+    radius_target = float(parameters.get("s", 1.0))
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype).reshape(-1)
+    residual = target - source
+    denom = mask.sum() + epsilon
+    covariance = ((residual * mask[:, None]).T @ residual / denom).detach()
+    # Stabilize the inverse while retaining the specified detached covariance.
+    covariance = covariance + epsilon * torch.eye(
+        covariance.shape[0], device=covariance.device, dtype=covariance.dtype
+    )
+    whitened = torch.linalg.solve(covariance, residual.T).T
+    projected = whitened @ codebook.T
+    direction = projected / (projected.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    p = F.softmax(source_logits, dim=1)
+    q = F.softmax(target_logits, dim=1)
+    h = ((q - p) * direction).sum(dim=1)
+    transport = (mask * F.relu(margin - h).square()).mean()
+
+    centered = codebook - codebook.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
+    radius_penalty = (centered.square().sum(dim=1) - radius_target).square().mean()
+    return lam * transport + nu * radius_penalty
